features.name: grid labyrinth rooms
features.notes: At least 36 interconnected rooms in a grid
features.quote: The layout should be a grid-based labyrinth of at least 36 interconnected rooms

features.name: identical room modules
features.notes: Each room approximately 12x12 studs or 4x4 meters
features.quote: Each room is approximately 12x12 studs (about 4x4 meters)

features.name: loop back corridors
features.notes: Openings should create short loops through the room grid
features.quote: Loop-Back Corridors: Openings cut so the identical rooms circle back into one another

features.name: pale yellow drywall walls
features.notes: Uniform monolithic pale yellow #d4c87a, slightly desaturated
features.quote: uniform monolithic pale yellow (#d4c87a) damp water-stained drywall

features.name: low acoustic tile ceiling
features.quote: low acoustic tile drop-ceiling (about 10 feet / 3 meters high)

features.name: fluorescent tube light rows
features.notes: Long ceiling rows, cool white with slight blue cast
features.quote: long rows of fluorescent tube light fixtures (cool white, slightly bluish)

features.name: beige patterned carpet
features.notes: Old commercial loop-pile carpet with subtle grey geometric repeating pattern
features.quote: old beige commercial loop-pile carpet with a subtle grey geometric repeating pattern

features.name: shadowless institutional lighting
features.notes: Flat lighting with no shadows; desaturated sickly grading
features.quote: No windows, no doors, no shadows

features.name: unbroken carpet flooring
features.notes: Carpet runs across every room floor
features.quote: running unbroken across every room floor
